description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for handling registration events such as saving, publishing, and gathering registration-related data, along with referencing external services and traits. The class facilitates registration event processing, interacting with DAOs, APIs, and organization services, and serves as a base for more specific registration event processors.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational methods for processing registration events, including saving events, gathering registration data, and publishing events, designed to be extended for specific registration event types.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO responsible for handling registration event queue persistence.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns the service used to communicate with the registration API.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Checks conditions and saves a new registration event if appropriate.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers and returns general registration data such as admin contact info, organization info, and system details.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object with event details to be saved.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes pending registration events if in production mode.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares event data with type and time info for publishing.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the type identifier for the event.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve data associated with the event.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to determine whether the event should be saved.
